sources: ReserveAmerica site list for parkId 630312, captured 2026-10-12 (audit/state_park_fees/mt_sites_2026-10-12.json)

values.note: 29 electric sites; electrical hookups May 1 - Nov 30.

hookups.source: https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/black-sandy-state-park/r/campsiteDetails.do?siteId=218&contractCode=MT&parkId=630312 (site 001 'Campsite Electric', 'Electricity Hookup: 50') + https://fwp.mt.gov/black-sandy ('29 campsites with electricity'; 'May 1- Nov 30: electrical hookups available'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 29 electric sites and 1 tent site (reservable) plus 5 non-electric tent sites (first-come). ReserveAmerica lists the electric sites as back-ins of 31-34 ft. Sites are close together; extra vehicles, trailers and toys will not fit in a site with the camping unit.

sites.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/black-sandy ('Black Sandy State Park has 29 campsites with electricity and one tent site that can be reserved, and 5 tent sites without electricity that are first come-first served. Maximum trailer length is 35 ft.') + ReserveAmerica site list (Campsite Electric 001-029 '31'/'34 Back-In') + site 001 page ('The campground is small with campsites right next to each other.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Potable water approximately May 15 - October 10 (as weather allows); limited facilities Dec 1 - May 1. Boat ramp and dock.

facilities.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/black-sandy (Amenities: 'RV Dump Station', 'Toilets (Flush)', 'Toilets (Vault)', 'Water', 'Boat Launch'; 'Potable water Approximately May 15-October 10 (as weather allows)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The 29 electric sites and one tent site are reservable; the 5 non-electric tent sites are first-come. For same-day availability call the park office (406-458-3221).

booking.source: https://fwp.mt.gov/black-sandy ('You can make reservations up to one day in advance of your arrival date. For same-day availability, try the park office-406-458-3221') + https://montanastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/black-sandy-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=MT&parkId=630312 (campsites: 'Reservations must be made 1 Day(s) ahead of arrival and can be made up to 3 Month(s) in advance.'), read 2026-10-22

note: MT FWP state park on the west shore of Hauser Lake, ~1/4 mi past White Sandy: a small, busy weekend boating, fishing and water-skiing park with sites close together. Boat launch; no lifeguard. --Claude
summary: FWP + ReserveAmerica: confirmed 35 sites (29 electric + 1 reservable tent + 5 FCFS tent), 35-ft limit, dump station, some sites first-come, year-round campground. Added 50-amp electric (site 001; hookups May 1 - Nov 30), flush and vault toilets, seasonal potable water, ReserveAmerica booking with 90-day window and 1-day cutoff. Fees (FWP schedule, human) left; FWP says only 'Campsite fees range from $4-$34'. Phone 406-458-3221 confirmed (park office May 15 - September). Note trimmed of restated values.
flags: Phone is seasonal: FWP gives the park office 406-458-3221 May 15 - September and the Helena Area Resource Office 406-495-3270 Labor Day - May 14.
